canonical_json_rule.whitespace: compact JSON separators comma=',' and colon=':'
canonical_json_rule.numbers: finite JSON numbers only; no NaN, Infinity or exponent rewriting
canonical_json_rule.nulls: preserve explicit null values; never omit a present null
canonical_json_rule.unicode: preserve Unicode code points with ensure_ascii=false; no NFC/NFD normalization
canonical_json_rule.hash: SHA-256 over the exact compact UTF-8 byte sequence
canonical_json_rule.rfc8785: project-defined canonical JSON; not RFC 8785 JCS

idempotency_keys.retry_rule: Source, TaskEnvelope and OutboxJob reuse one operation id/key; one activation transaction sets enabled and queued.
same content version maps to one Content row
reuse canonical Event and append member once
Publication, OutboxJob and TaskEnvelope use exact Publication.idempotency_key; reconcile query uses exact Publication.reconcile_key; one bundle/hash has one public_id.

runtime_fence.stale_rejection: Missing, unknown, zero, non-monotonic epoch or expired lease rejects before provider/outbox/commit/publish/stop side effects.
runtime_fence.epoch_zero_policy: epoch=0 is always an invalid input and must be schema-rejected; it is not a valid live envelope.
runtime_fence.lease_policy: live lease is at least 128-bit opaque; synthetic fixture shape is synthetic:lease:<32 lowercase hex characters>.

invariants.rule: Base is the only accepted A/D business truth; local contract and snapshot cannot write back or become a second truth; M3 unknown/pending/proposed/false/null values and disabled shadow rows remain unchanged.

Validating requires canonical_url_valid, normalization_status=valid and dedup_status=unique; platform, authorization and adapter block in that priority; one activation transaction binds Source, TaskEnvelope and Outbox operation/key and atomically writes enabled false→true plus queued.
Task/publication/outbox work requires a fresh five-epoch envelope and lease, bounded window and CAS; stale, zero, missing or non-monotonic fences cannot call a provider or update current results.

Publication, OutboxJob and TaskEnvelope reuse the exact Publication.idempotency_key and reconcile_key; one release_bundle_id plus bundle_hash has at most one Publication/public_id/generation and PublishedProjection is read-only derived.

Content, Summary, ReleaseBundle canonical payload/bundle inputs and ReviewDecision approval hashes are explicit, canonical-json-v1 recomputable and immutable; approved_bundle_hash equals the current Bundle hash and changed frozen input supersedes approval.

reconcile_wait has independent confirmed-published, confirmed-not-submitted, terminal-failure and emergency-stop outcomes; all preserve one Publication identity/key, while partial or stale snapshots retain last-known-good and never promote a candidate hash.
SourceObservation and AuditEvent are internal-only, additionalProperties=false, synthetic and never enter domain/Base/public DTO; SummaryDraft is Summary(summary_status=draft), not a new entity.
AuditEvent is append-only with monotonic sequence, occurred_at/clock, redaction, retention/cleanup, owner, operation/task/epoch/hash evidence and no secrets, original content or private identifiers.
No credential, personal identifier, real content, real URL or unauthorized media is stored in synthetic fixtures; all security/error fixtures remain synthetic_only with external_calls=0.

migration_boundary.m3_to_local: M3 33/9 fields seed Source and CapturedItem only; migration_batch_id remains traceable.
migration_boundary.real_content: No real post, private content, platform account ID, token or media is imported by this contract task.
migration_boundary.provider: No Base resource write, Base truth switch, base_direct/base_snapshot switch or Collector call is allowed here.
migration_boundary.internal: Internal contract is separate from domain schema and Base mapping; no SourceObservation/SummaryDraft/AuditEvent field is a domain truth.
migration_boundary.future_extension: New domain entities or enum values require a new contract version and migration review.
